entities.summary: Colin Muller is a Canadian-born Swiss professional ice hockey coach and former professional ice hockey player. Muller played ice hockey in the Swiss A league from 1983 to 2000 and has been coaching in Switzerland since 2000. He is currently serving as the head coach of the Swiss women's national team.
